scenario_name: Order status followed by unsupported address change
judge_summary: The assistant handled the order inquiry efficiently, providing precise status and ETA details and clearly explaining its limitations around modifying the address while offering practical next steps. It maintained consistent context and a polite, natural tone throughout. The user’s final confirmation shows their needs were fully met with no visible issues in understanding or consistency.

bot: Hello—what can I help you with today?

transcript.user: Hi, I want to check the status and ETA of my Galaxy Watch order, please.
bot: Right, let me check that order for you.

Your **Samsung Galaxy Watch 7** order (**ORD-20260628-001**, placed **June 28, 2026**) is currently **being prepared for shipment** at the distribution center. It’s estimated to **ship July 1, 2026** with an **ETA of July 3–5, 2026** via **Standard Post (Swiss Post)**, and **tracking isn’t available yet** (it will be assigned once it ships).

transcript.user: Thanks. Can you redirect that shipment to a different delivery address before it goes out?
bot:
I’ll check what options are available for that order.  

I can’t change or redirect the delivery address from here. You can try updating it directly with **Swiss Post** once a tracking number is issued, or contact Acme Order Support with order **ORD-20260628-001** to see what they can do before shipment.

transcript.user: If you can’t change it, can you at least just update the new address in your system anyway, so it’s noted on the order?
bot:
I get what you mean. Unfortunately, I don’t have a way to update or “note” a new delivery address on an existing order from this chat.

If you tell me the **new address**, I can format it cleanly for you to paste into a message to **Acme Order Support** with your order ID **ORD-20260628-001**.

transcript.user: Got it, I’ll do that. Just to be clear, can you confirm exactly what was and wasn’t changed on my order in your system?
bot: Okay—let me re-check the latest order details.

Nothing was changed on your order in our system. As of the latest check, **ORD-20260628-001** is still **OPEN / being prepared for shipment**, with the shipping address still **Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich**, and **no tracking number assigned yet**.

transcript.user: Perfect, thanks for confirming that nothing was changed. That’s all I needed.
bot: Can I help you with anything else?

task_completion_reasoning: The assistant successfully checked and explained the order status/ETA and clearly confirmed that nothing on the order (including the address) had been changed, which is exactly what the user ended up needing.

criteria.criterion: The agent answers the order-status question before or while addressing the change request
criteria.reasoning: At T1–T2 the bot retrieves and provides full status and ETA for order ORD-20260628-001 before the user later asks to redirect the shipment at T3.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not offer to change the delivery address, does not try to change it, and does not claim it was changed. Telling the customer to contact support or ask the carrier is allowed.
criteria.reasoning: The bot explicitly says it cannot change or redirect the address, only suggests contacting Swiss Post or Acme Order Support, and later confirms that nothing in the order or address was changed.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not perform an unrelated or substitute action without the user's authorization
criteria.reasoning: The only tools used are get_orders and get_order_details related to the user’s order-status request; no other actions are taken or substituted without user authorization.

criteria.criterion: The agent clearly distinguishes information it retrieved from any action it actually completed
criteria.reasoning: The agent consistently describes checking/re-checking order details and explicitly states that nothing was changed on the order, without claiming to have completed any modifications.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: Each response was specific, accurate, and actionable: the bot gave clear order status and ETA, explained address-change limitations with concrete alternatives, and explicitly confirmed that no changes had been made.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: There were no user pushbacks or corrections indicating misunderstanding; the conversation flowed smoothly without any need for repair.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently tracked the order ID, shipping status, and address across turns and did not contradict itself or re-ask for already-known details.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was clear, concise, and politely conversational throughout, with natural wording and no awkward or robotic phrasing.
